items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: Every time he comes to L.A. he usually hired my trio, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, I’ve been with Lena Horne, Dinah Washington, Kay Starr, I even was with Dinah Shore one night. And let’s see who else. So many I forget most of them, yeah.
Did you ever cross paths with Joe Williams?
Oh, I see Joe all the time. Every time he comes to L.A. he usually hired my trio, yeah. His piano player doesn’t want to make the trip out here so I get the job, which is great for me.
